data.title: Market Research vs User Research: What's the Real Difference?
data.html_title: Market Research vs User Research: What's the Real Difference?
data.html_description: Ask most product and marketing teams about their research strategy, and you'll likely hear these terms used interchangeably. Yet, conflating market research with user research is one of the biggest mistakes that can derail a product or campaign.
